{{Quote|You think me stupid, Ore'mun? You think I do not know that you are Skal'nas's spy? You think I could not sense your lust for my command? Or feel your pleasure in relaying the order? Stupid, that!|Predor Tul'kar|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" />}}
'''Ore'mun''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] who served in the [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]], a Rakatan overlord. When [[Tul'kar]], another Predor, led Rakatan forces to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[25,793 BBY]] to [[Conquest of Tatooine|gather]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individuals and cull [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitives from the [[Kumumgah/Legends|natives]], Ore'mun accompanied him on Skal'nas's orders. Ore'mun lusted for Tul'kar's command of the conquest, and when it was given to the spy via new orders from Skal'nas, Tul'kar angrily [[Death/Legends|killed]] a smug Ore'mun with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and prepared to [[Cannibalism|eat the corpse]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Predor Skal'nas has sent a message, ordering you back to Byss. I am to stay to oversee the culling.|Ore'mun, to Predor Tul'kar|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" />}}
Ore'mun was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]],<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" /> a member of a naturally [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> whose [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] ruled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] fueled all Rakatan technology,<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and the Empire accordingly sought out and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] whose populations were strong in the Force through the use of Force-sensitives known as [[Force Hound]]s.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> In [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> Ore'mun served the Infinite Empire as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]],<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" /> a Rakatan overlord.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 0" /> Skal'nas dispatched Ore'mun to accompany the subordinate yet ambitious Predor [[Tul'kar]] on a [[Conquest of Tatooine|conquest]] of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which had been discovered by Tul'kar's Force Hound [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]].<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" />

[[File:Oremun-death-DotJ1.png|thumb|left|Ore'mun demise at the hand of Tul'kar.]]
The [[Rakatan ship|starships]] of the Infinite Empire arrived at the lush world, and Rakatan warriors subjugated the native [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]]. On the outskirts of a [[Unidentified Tatooine city|burning city]], Ore'mun watched as Xesh identified Force-sensitives among the locals; the spy then received new orders transmitted from Skal'nas. Ore'mun complimented Tul'kar on Xesh's abilities in such a way as to point out that Skal'nas was his superior, and then confidently relayed the orders: Tul'kar had been summoned to meet with Skal'nas on the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], and Ore'mun was to remain on Tatooine to oversee the culling of local Force-sensitives. Furious with the display of smugness, Tul'kar [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically choked]] Ore'mun and killed the spy with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Ore'mun's body was then prepared by Tul'kar's minions so the Predor could [[Cannibalism|eat]] his conquered foe.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Xesh's abilities are superior, Predor Tul'kar&mdash;it is a wonder Predor Skal'nas has not commandeered him.|Ore'mun|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" />}}
As a Rakatan, Ore'mun<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" /> was sensitive to the Force.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" /> Ore'mun was ambitious and lusted for Predor Tul'kar's command of the conquest of Tatooine, emotions that Tul'kar was able to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] through the Force. The spy took pleasure in relaying Skal'nas's order that Tul'kar return to Byss, and took care to remind the Predor that he was Skal'nas's inferior. Ore'mun had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and no [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ore'mun's appeared in [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. The issue was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 1" /> on [[February 15]], [[2012]],<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/18-026/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-1-Jan-Duursema-cover|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi #1 (Jan Duursema Cover)}}</ref>
